tex_content.html:
Corollary
1. ch10:10.25

Let $\gamma $ be a geodesic segment and let $V$ be a proper normal piecewise smooth vector field along it. Then $I(V,W)=0$ for every proper normal piecewise smooth field $W$ along $\gamma $ if and only if $V$ is a Jacobi field.
